tasks.instruction: In routes.py, make the retry branch increment attempts only when the response is transient, while keeping the fallback return inside the function.
Update labels.py so format_label accepts an optional suffix and uses it when provided; keep the existing call working.
Add a normalize_code helper to series.py that returns an uppercase, trimmed code, and keep the command-line example below it.
In quota.py, add a configurable reserve to remaining(), then update the example to call remaining with a reserve of 2.
In route.js, place the audit call inside the approved branch, and leave the denied response in the alternate branch.
Change format.js so formatLabel accepts an optional suffix and applies it when supplied; preserve the existing one-argument call.
Add a normalizeCode helper to series.js that trims and uppercases a value, without changing the existing total function.
In policy.js, add a reserve argument to remaining(), subtract it from the result, and update the example call to pass 2.
In RouteTable.java, keep the audit assignment within the matched branch and preserve the fallback result for unmatched paths.
Update LabelMaker.java so formatLabel accepts an optional suffix as a second argument, and update its existing call site.
Add a public normalizeCode method to Series.java that trims and uppercases its input; keep the existing total method intact.
In QuotaPolicy.java, add a reserve parameter to remaining(), subtract it safely, and update the main example to pass a reserve of 2.

QuotaPolicy.java: remaining(int limit, int used, int reserve)
